Tip:
You can expel someone for 2 floors (this floor and the next one)! You can't keep the hammer forever and you will lose your purchase if you don't use it on this or the next floor!
Explore the Key Bindings options menu to customize the game controls for yourself!
WD-NoSquee creates a silent area which makes everything squee-less! You can drown out even Chalkles! The effect ends in 5 minutes.
While you are invisible, no one can see you, but Baldi can still hear and catch you!
The Alarm Clock can be moved by whirlpools, conveyor belts, wind, BSODAs, and that can be used to your advantage! For example, you could place it down to remove a whirpool!
If Playtime sees you or catches you, try to turn a corner or get into a blue locker! That will cancel her minigame or make her go the other way!
Make sure to get activities right! If you don't, Baldi will get angrier!
Try to think fast! Sometimes situations go fast, and pausing could help you comprehend them!
Are you riding on a 'Nana Peel and need to stop immediately? Just use BSODA or Diet BSODA!
You can't use and wear multiple Wind Blowers at same time!
Some vending machines can be CRAZY! These vending machines give random items, but have rare chance to appear...
Use the Principal's Whistle to get rid of It's a Bully if you see him!
Despite there being gaps, the other characters can't see through It's a Bully!
Want to get into the lockers without attracting Baldi's attention? Use WD-NoSquee to mute sounds in their area!
Nobody can see you if you are squished during Flood event!
If First Prize bothers you, use the Safety Scissors on it!
If you are slowed from bubblegum, don't spend stamina! Wait until effect ends or use the Safety Scissors!
You can use the Portal Poster to escape detention every time for the rest of an attempt!
If you shoot a Grappling Hook at one position multiple times, it will pull you faster! This is useful in the Grapple Challenge.
The Principal's Keys can open any standard door! You may need to use them in situations like when Chalkes locked you in the Classroom!
You can use Wind Blower to push around 'Nana Peels, or even push a character towards the Principal's Office door to free yourself!
Bubblegum flies towards you and cannot avoid it..? Drink BSODA to push gum away!
Do you want to escape from the Principal's Office without being caught again? Equip a Faculty Tag!
Have you been frozen by Cold School random event? Just run more and collect notebooks to warm up!
While you're sliding with the help of Ice Boots, Baldi can't catch you!
Not only 'Nana Peels can be used to make characters slip away, but you can also slip on them yourself and be slightly faster!
Do not eat the Energy Flavored Zesty Bars twice at time! It's pointless and your stamina will have same value. Spend stamina first and then eat the second Zesty Bar!
If you speedrun BB+ and don't care about YTPs, you can get the math machines' questions wrong while Baldi is counting for that extra second!
The Principal of the Thing can open locked doors! Use the Principal's Whistle to force him to release you from the locked room!
Are you in a sticky situation but a blue locker is in sight? Use the Super Stretchy Glove! Even after you leave the locker, you will appear in the same place where you entered!
The Faculty Only Super Doors need to see you close, so if you can't be seen, you can pass! Invisibility effect or Faculty Tag will help you trick them!
If a conveyor belt is blocking your path on Factory, click its button to reverse the direction! You can reach button via running or using Grappling Hook, Super Stretchy Glove.
There are many ways to get inside a locked Faculty Room! You can break the windows, use the Portal Poster or teleport inside. If you do this it will unlock automatically!
Read the posters! Recipe posters are designed to let you know what you can cook! They are very handy.
Characters can use the Laboratory teleporters too! Just pick a destination, throw a 'Nana peel in front of the room's entrance door and let them slip in right direction!
Every time you give a student a lost item, the YTPs the next one will give you are increased by 25! This resets back to 100 after you beat the floor or get caught, though.
Every time you load a level, the items will change, regardless of seed!
Don't feel like following the wires on the Maintenance? You can just look at the Advanced Map, as activating a power lever reveals the classroom on the map it's connected to!
The laboratory is split into 4 sections by the Wormhole room and Faculty Only Super Doors. Use the Wormhole and Teleporters to travel between them!
Characters' hitboxes are very thin so aim your Boxing Glove well!
Valves have the exact same mechanics as the Dirty Chalk Eraser clouds! This means that characters are blind in the steam.
Be careful while you are squished or flipped! Entities like BSODA or 'Nana Peel which you spawn can copy your status effects!
Pay attention to classroom chalkboards! They describe how activities work!
